-- Spam control flag
local spamming = false

-- Function to spam remote events
local function spamRemotes()
    spawn(function()
        while spamming do
            -- Give Money Remote
            pcall(function()
                local args = {
                    {
                        value = 9e300, -- huge but safe number
                        type = "Money",
                        chance = 0.45

                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("Remotes"):WaitForChild("Roulette"):WaitForChild("GiveOutReward"):FireServer(unpack(args))

        end
    end)

        spamRemotes()

scripts.script:
-- Server script: aplica Korblox (perna direita) + Headless (cabeça) para TODOS os jogadores (só R6)
-- Colocar em ServerScriptService

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local MESH_ID = "rbxassetid://101851696"   -- mesh fornecido
local TEXTURE_ID = "rbxassetid://101851254" -- texture fornecido

-- Função que limpa meshes/decals acessórios que possam conflitar
local function limparParte(part)
    if not part then return end

    -- Remove CharacterMesh / SpecialMesh / MeshPart filhos que possam conflitar
    for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("SpecialMesh") or child:IsA("CharacterMesh") or child:IsA("MeshPart") then
            child:Destroy()
        elseif child:IsA("Decal") or child:IsA("Texture") then
            child:Destroy() -- remove rosto/decals
        end
    end
end

-- Aplica Korblox + Headless a um character (só se for R6)
local function aplicarKorbloxHeadless(character)
    if not character then return end
    local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not humanoid then return end

    if humanoid.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
        return -- não faz nada se não for R6
    end

    -- HEAD (Headless)
    local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
    if head and head:IsA("BasePart") then
        limparParte(head)

        head.Transparency = 1
        head.CanCollide = false

        local face = head:FindFirstChild("face")
        if face and face:IsA("Decal") then face:Destroy() end

        local headMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        headMesh.Name = "HeadlessMesh"
        headMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
        headMesh.MeshId = MESH_ID
        headMesh.TextureId = TEXTURE_ID
        headMesh.Parent = head
    end

    -- RIGHT LEG (Korblox)
    local rightLeg = character:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")
    if rightLeg and rightLeg:IsA("BasePart") then
        limparParte(rightLeg)

        local legMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
        legMesh.Name = "KorbloxMesh"
        legMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
        legMesh.MeshId = MESH_ID
        legMesh.TextureId = TEXTURE_ID
        legMesh.Parent = rightLeg
    end
end

-- Conecta ao spawn do personagem
local function onPlayerAdded(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(character)
        -- espera as partes principais aparecerem
        character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
        character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
        character:WaitForChild("Right Leg", 5)

        -- aplica logo depois de spawnar
        task.wait(0.5) -- pequeno delay para evitar bug visual
        aplicarKorbloxHeadless(character)
    end)

    -- Se já tiver um personagem carregado (ex: entrar no jogo spawnado)
    if player.Character then
        aplicarKorbloxHeadless(player.Character)
    end
end

-- Ativa para todos os jogadores
Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    onPlayerAdded(p)
end

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

-- Altura acima da água
local alturaAcimaAgua = 3

-- Atualiza a posição constantemente
game:GetService("RunService").RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local pos = rootPart.Position
    -- Verifica se há água abaixo do personagem
    local region = Region3.new(pos - Vector3.new(2,5,2), pos + Vector3.new(2,0,2))
    local partes = workspace:FindPartsInRegion3(region, nil, 100)
    
    for _, parte in ipairs(partes) do
        if parte.Material == Enum.Material.Water then
            -- Mantém o personagem flutuando sobre a água
            rootPart.Position = Vector3.new(pos.X, parte.Position.Y + alturaAcimaAgua, pos.Z)
        end
    end
end)

scripts.script:
-- LocalScript: Korblox + Headless + Orador da Morte (perna esquerda)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

-- IDs reais
local KORBLOX_MESH_ID = "rbxassetid://101851696"
local KORBLOX_TEXTURE_ID = "rbxassetid://101851254"
local HEADLESS_MESH_ID = "rbxassetid://123456789" -- Headless hipotético
local ORADOR_LEFT_LEG_MESH_ID = "rbxassetid://139607673"
local ORADOR_LEFT_LEG_TEXTURE_ID = "" -- pode deixar vazio se não tiver texture

-- Função para aplicar SpecialMesh
local function applyMesh(part, meshId, textureId, scale)
    if not part then return end
    local mesh = part:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
    if mesh then mesh:Destroy() end

    local specialMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
    specialMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.FileMesh
    specialMesh.MeshId = meshId
    specialMesh.TextureId = textureId or ""
    specialMesh.Scale = scale or Vector3.new(1,1,1)
    specialMesh.Parent = part
end

-- Aplica Headless
local head = character:FindFirstChild("Head")
if head then
    applyMesh(head, HEADLESS_MESH_ID, "", Vector3.new(1,1,1))
end

-- Aplica Korblox na perna direita
local rightLeg = character:FindFirstChild("Right Leg") or character:FindFirstChild("RightLowerLeg")
applyMesh(rightLeg, KORBLOX_MESH_ID, KORBLOX_TEXTURE_ID, Vector3.new(1,1,1))

-- Aplica Orador da Morte na perna esquerda
local leftLeg = character:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") or character:FindFirstChild("LeftLowerLeg")
applyMesh(leftLeg, ORADOR_LEFT_LEG_MESH_ID, ORADOR_LEFT_LEG_TEXTURE_ID, Vector3.new(1,1,1))
